description: Registrar General's Department - Extended two years of Registration of Deaths (Temporary Provisions)
categorisation: The gazette content pertains to the extension of a legal regulation under the Registration of Deaths (Temporary Provision) Act, No. 19 of 2010. This involves a regulatory matter and the modification of a legal framework, which fits the definition of a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5). While a minister's name is present, it is only in the capacity of issuing the regulation and does not involve a personnel change or detailed portfolio description, so government Types 1-3 do not apply. The content is not related to land, commerce, elections, public service, or judicial matters.
